Could represent power_supply_voltage as value list? The schema says value can be number, range, or string. Two separate supply options: 100-240 V AC and 13.8 V DC. I could emit two characteristics entries? The schema's type_level is a map of label → one value. Hmm. Options: 
  - power_supply_voltage: {value: {min: 100, max: 240}, unit_symbol: "V"} and add note via another attribute like "power_supply_voltage_alternate": 13.8 V DC. That's a bit fabricated in naming.
  - Or use config_level with axis "power_supply": conditions "AC mains", "DC". That fits: attribute power_supply_voltage, axis "power_supply_type", values [{condition: "AC", value {min:100,max:240}, unit V}, {condition: "DC", value 13.8, unit "V"}]. That seems clean.
  
  Per rule 3 example: 110-240V AC 50/60Hz splits into voltage, frequency, type. Here we have two supply options. I'll use config_level for voltage with axis "power_supply_type" (AC vs DC), plus type_level power_supply_frequency {min 50, max 60} Hz (applies to AC), and power_supply_type as... hmm if I use config_level axis, then also having power_supply_type as separate is redundant. Alternative: type_level: power_supply_voltage_ac: {min 100, max 240} V; power_supply_voltage_dc: 13.8 V; power_supply_frequency: {50-60} Hz; power_supply_type: "AC or DC"? That creates label variants.

  I think config_level is appropriate: axis "power_supply_type". Values: {condition: "AC", value: {min:100, max:240}, unit_symbol: "V"} and {condition: "DC", value: 13.8, unit_symbol: "V"}. And type_level power_supply_frequency {min 50, max 60} Hz. Actually the frequency applies only to AC; config-level too? Keep simple: config_level entries for both voltage and frequency? The DC option has no frequency. I'll do:
  - config_level: attribute "power_supply_voltage", axis "power_supply_type", values: [{condition "AC", value {100-240}, unit V}, {condition "DC", value 13.8, unit V}]
  - config_level: attribute "power_supply_frequency", axis "power_supply_type", values: [{condition "AC", value {50-60}, unit Hz}]
  
  Hmm, but rule 5 config axis example is about weighing configurations. Either way acceptable. Alternatively simpler: type_level power_supply_voltage as value string? No — strict structured values.

  I'll go with config_level approach.

  Actually, maybe simpler and safer: type_level with two attributes: "power_supply_voltage" → can't hold two ranges in one value object... The schema's structured value shape only allows single number/range/string. A list isn't allowed. So config_level it is.
